contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constasntine (306-361), Trier mint fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Head diademed right, seen from front. Reverse description: [soldier advancing left spearing] fallen horseman; a small horseman with both arms over his head and legs in the air falls left from a large and brindled horse. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP] REPARATIO. In exergue: PTR. Diameter: 17.2mm, Weight: 2.09gms, die axis: 9
